description: All prices, volumes, news, stock, and human responses are synthetic. Region and item identifiers describe the intended ESI mapping only.

objective.goal: Assess seven-day Tritanium stocking and logistics options for The Forge using market history, news, current stock, and board findings.

market_history.source: synthetic; intended mapping: ESI regional daily market history

news.text: A fictional community announcement proposes increased manufacturing activity. Participation and market impact are unverified. This is not a real EVE announcement.

operator_feedback.text: Synthetic warehouse receipt increased stock after the prior snapshot. Reassess stocking requirements; this report does not prove a market purchase was executed.

future_runner_checks: Two specialists examine market data and news provenance independently.
The coordinator distinguishes historical regional prices from current executable orders.
The coordinator treats speculative news as uncertain evidence, not a confirmed demand forecast.
Operator correction creates a new assessment version without erasing the previous finding.
Duplicate feedback does not create a duplicate task or notification.
No game action is implied by an assessment or an operator acknowledgment.
